data.name: Time for Random Ability Defense
data.detailed_description:
Game Overview

You will play as a powerful meme master, using wisdom and strategy to build a unique combination of meme skills to resist waves of increasingly powerful enemies. Collect coins and meme spirits, extract various meme skills, and protect the source of all joy and resonance - the "meme crystal" base

Core game features

🎲 Versatile meme technique, random combination

There are nearly a hundred imaginative meme skills built into the game, covering various types such as attack, defense, assistance, summoning, etc. Every draw is a surprise, from "Kimi Storm" to "Sun in the Heart", from "Killing Intent Fluctuations" to "Crowd Foot Storm", every choice you make will change the course of the battle.

Core gameplay: There is a powerful combination of skills that creates a binding effect. For example, equipping both "Capture Bright Light" and "Release Darkness" can trigger the "Player Voice" combination, causing range damage; Collecting "Spider Sense" and "Real Man" can activate the "Four Hundred Aunties" and immediately cause counterattack damage when attracting hatred.

💰 Strategic growth, strategic planning

Get gold coins and rare resource memes by killing enemies. Gold coins are used to upgrade skills, while meme spirits are the key to extracting powerful meme skills.

How to allocate resources, should we prioritize upgrading our strength steadily, or take a gamble to extract key skills in order to change our destiny? Every game is a brand new strategy test.

🦾 Dynamic enemies, full of challenges

The enemy will gradually become stronger as the waves advance, and each wave may see elite enemies with unique skills, such as spraying flames, summoning allies, or strengthening companions. Be careful when facing bosses with unique mechanisms! It has destructive skills that require you to give it your all and use the perfect combination of skills to defeat.

🏆 Deep process, endless glory

Skill field unlocking: After completing the simple difficulty level for the first time, additional talent fields will be unlocked, allowing you to build more complex and powerful combination systems in subsequent challenges.

Extreme difficulty challenge: Completing the basic mode is just the beginning! Bravely face the difficulty of nightmares, even activate custom difficulty, manually adjust enemy attribute magnification, and challenge your limits.

Global leaderboard: In custom high magnification nightmare difficulty, every second of survival is crucial. Use your wisdom and skills to rank on the global leaderboard, proving to all players who is truly the "ultimate meme master"!

Are you ready to welcome this frenzy of memes and imagination?

Gather your skills, protect the meme crystal, and leave your legend behind!

data.short_description: This is a multiplayer online base defense game! Engage in intense 20-minute matches, team up to draw skills and create powerful combos. Battle increasingly stronger monster waves and defeat timed elite enemies and bosses. Join the fight and protect the last Meme Crystals!
data.supported_languages: English, Simplified Chinese, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Japanese, Polish, Swedish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Korean
